name: join-key-direction
description: Compare fact-side and dimension-side hash-build directions

queries.name: fact-build
queries.sql: SELECT e.event_id, a.tier FROM events e JOIN accounts a ON e.user_id = a.user_id ORDER BY e.event_id LIMIT 20

queries.name: reverse-build
queries.sql: SELECT e.event_id, a.tier FROM accounts a JOIN events e ON a.user_id = e.user_id ORDER BY e.event_id LIMIT 20

queries.name: reverse-key-order
queries.sql: SELECT e.event_id, a.tier FROM events e INNER JOIN accounts a ON a.user_id = e.user_id ORDER BY e.event_id LIMIT 20
